_context.update.ready: Toast inside the desktop app when a new version of the app was downloaded. {version} is like 0.4.0.
_context.update.restart: Button of that toast: restarts the desktop app to install the new version.
_context.downloads.done: Toast inside the desktop app when a file finished downloading. {filename} is the file name.
_context.downloads.show: Button of that toast: shows the file in Finder (macOS) or Explorer (Windows).
_context.handoff.title: Page opened in the web browser by the Rerun desktop app to sign it in. {app} is the app name (Rerun, Rerun Staging).
_context.handoff.body: {account} is the email address (or phone number) of the signed-in account.
_context.handoff.codeHint: Shown after confirming, in case the desktop app did not open by itself.
_context.signIn.waitingTitle: Shown in the desktop app after it opened the web browser to sign in.
_context.signIn.codeLabel: Label of the field where the person pastes the code shown by the browser.
_context.settings.version: Under the Updates row of the desktop app settings. {version} is like 0.4.0.
_context.openInApp.title: Toast in the web browser, offering to open the current page in the Rerun desktop app. {app} is the app name.
_context.quickAsk.placeholder: Placeholder of the small floating window of the desktop app where the person types a question for the Chief of Staff (the workspace assistant).
_context.server.otherServer: Discreet link on the sign-in page of the desktop app, for people whose company hosts Rerun itself.

update.description: Restart the app to use the new version.

handoff.title: Sign in to {app}
handoff.doneBody: {app} finishes signing in on its own. You can close this tab.
handoff.codeHint: If {app} did not open, paste this code into it:
handoff.failed: Couldn’t sign the app in. Try again.
handoff.invalidBody: Start the sign-in again from the desktop app.

signIn.waitingBody: Sign in in the browser window that opened, then come back here.

errors.expired: This code has expired. Start again.
errors.invalid: This code isn’t valid. Start again.
errors.state-mismatch: This sign-in was started from another window. Start again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach Rerun. Check your connection.

settings.openAtLoginMac: Rerun starts with your Mac, in the menu bar.
settings.openAtLoginOther: Rerun starts with your computer, in the notification area.
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window leaves Rerun in the notification area, so notifications still arrive.
settings.quickAskHint: {shortcut} opens a field for your Chief of Staff from any app.

quickAsk.hint: Enter to send, Esc to close
